Send back the `kind` from the card's `action`; a kind the card does not offer is refused. Every action starts a visible chat turn whose message is what the reader accepted: the card's proposal when the app, by `x-app-id`, shows the action in the idea slot and the card has one, otherwise the button label; the response's `next` is `open_chat` and carries the turn's `execution_id`. Proof of concept./feed/units/{unit_id}/actiondaemon_goals_clear_fixed_positionsClear all goal fixed positionsAtomically clears fixed_position on all goals and subgoals across both sources and every lifecycle status. Takes no request body. Preserves hierarchy, sort_order, attention, and activity timestamps, restoring the existing ordering without fixed overrides. Returns the IDs changed by this request and attempts a goal.updated broadcast for each after committing. Repeated calls with no fixed goals succeed with an empty updated_goal_ids array. Refresh the goal list and restart pagination after clearing positions.Goalsdaemon_sharing_attemptRecord an explicit message sharing attemptRecords one explicit user share action and returns one authoritative disposition: allow, allow_with_friction, or block. The client supplies a UUID share_operation_id and reuses it for transport retries. content_type=message identifies the exact assistant response. The legacy can_broadcast_share projection is true only for allow and false for allow_with_friction or block, so clients that do not consume disposition continue to block friction. New clients must render Review before sharing before acting on allow_with_friction; the server does not negotiate client capability. This endpoint does not publish content. Shadow review remains telemetry-only. Under enforcement it waits up to 30 seconds for current review; timeout remains fail-closed while review work continues in the background.Sharingdaemon_sharing_eligibilityCheck broadcast sharing eligibilityReports whether identified content may be broadcast shared. Identify the content with its logical content_type namespace and the canonical content_id from the owning API. Muse message ids are unique across main chats and side chats; provider-native message ids are not canonical. For content_type=message, a new public assistant message starts fail-closed while its decision is pending. At finalization, decoded JSON content matches in either direction between complete content sentences and complete visible-text sentences. Embedded matches require at least eight Unicode scalars or four East Asian letters; shorter segments match only the whole trimmed message. The reverse visible-sentence scan also applies a conservative prose and metadata filter. Multi-word prose such as I have ALS. remains matching evidence with short uppercase words or acronyms; digits, URLs, paths, IDs, timestamps, separators, and long enum-like uppercase tokens remain excluded. JSON metadata and control fields remain excluded. Identity objects and arrays are traversed for nested content while direct identity scalars and identity metadata remain excluded. For formatted non-JSON output, the whole opaque blob is exact-match only. Separate filtered sentences perform wrapped and partial matching: phone numbers formatted with spaces, hyphens, or parentheses and prose-like right-hand values from known metadata assignments remain candidates. URLs, paths, identifiers, timestamps, UUIDs, dotted numeric values, numeric or enum-like assignments, and metadata-heavy rows remain excluded. Only eligible output preceding the message after the latest compaction checkpoint participates. Matching is bounded; malformed, incomplete, over-limit, invalid, or unavailable evidence keeps a text-bearing message fail-closed. A missing runtime-owned temporary spill may use its surviving model-visible preview only when prompt and source records are aligned, its source has sequenced durable-history provenance from a prior execution, and no later function call follows it. Current, root, and sequence-less sources are denied; the no-later-call check establishes that content beyond the preview was not consumed. Runtime-authored JSON string truncation markers carry the exact page-reference digest; legacy, forged, or malformed markers fail closed. The original byte count caps reconstruction, with inconsistent bounds or executor-cap risk failing closed. JSON repair never invents an omitted suffix. It may complete exactly one unterminated trailing string value by JSON-decoding its retained encoded fragment and re-encoding the decoded prefix. A partial backslash or Unicode escape fails closed; the whole repaired JSON must parse and leave at least one eligible retained candidate. Other structural repair rewinds at most eight Unicode scalars. Valid complete and preview envelopes give each non-empty stderr and tail the same opaque-whole-stream plus filtered-sentence treatment; marker-free non-JSON stdout uses that path too. Runtime-temporary references use one no-follow open: only NotFound is missing, while symlink and permission failures are invalid. Pending-only or combined-output truncation keeps complete retained streams. Commands with no retained stdout, stderr, or tail, structured pre-execution failures, and runtime-authored refusals contribute no content. Messages are decided independently, textless messages become shareable, and historical messages without a persisted decision or non-message locators retain the compatible shareable result. For content_type=message reviews only that exact assistant response. Conversation-level sharing is unsupported. When conversation review enforcement is offâ€”including whenever review itself is disabledâ€”can_broadcast_share uses that message's existing deterministic decision, while passive reads never start review work and continue returning that deterministic preflight result. An explicit sharing attempt starts or reuses review. Shadow verdicts remain telemetry-only. Under enforcement the authoritative disposition is allow, allow_with_friction, or block. Clients must render Review before sharing before acting on allow_with_friction; the server does not negotiate client capability. Missing, stale, pending, and failed reviews produce block.blockedexternal_storage_semantic_checkevent
